title: Options Core Report Envelope v1
description: Lean pointer-style envelope emitted as report.json by options-core. Carries metadata + (eventually) structured insights[]. Full dashboard payload lives at dashboard/data.json (legacy) or the content-addressed dashboard/data-{hash}.json (preferred for caching).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this envelope schema.

generated_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this report was generated.

source.description: Identifier of the engine that produced this report.

schema_url.description: Canonical URL of this schema file.

ticker_count.description: Number of tickers covered in the underlying data payload (informational).

strategy_count.description: Number of distinct strategies present in strategy_stats (informational).

data_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the dashboard payload, also used in data_url_v2 filename.

data_url.description: Relative path (from the data-repo root) to the legacy mutable data.json.

data_url_v2.description: Relative path to the content-addressed immutable data-{hash}.json (preferred for CDN caching).

insights.description: Structured insight objects, sorted critical-first. Empty array when no insights are emitted yet (options-core is in transition to V2-style insights).
